name: loop-runner
description: Dynamic non-blocking agy-loop workflow runner with pre-iteration probes, two-stage turn-stopping verification, parallel target execution, stateful session rotation, inbox control, and strict budget enforcement.

loop_id.description: Optional pre-allocated loop ID (lp_YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ_<4hex>). Generated automatically if omitted.

workspace_dir.description: Absolute or resolved path to the target workspace root directory.

task_source.description: Task origin: 'inline' prompt or 'loop_md_or_default' live-reloaded loop.md / builtin fallback.

prompt.description: Inline task prompt when task_source is 'inline'.

pacing.description: Pacing mode: 'dynamic' self-paced delay or 'fixed' interval_sec.

once.description: Run a single iteration (or delayed one-shot when interval_sec > 0) and exit.

interval_sec.description: Fixed inter-iteration sleep interval in seconds (or initial delay when once is true).

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of loop iterations before stopping with max_reached (default 20, or 1 when once is true).

state_mode.description: Worker context mode: 'fresh' per iteration or 'stateful' persistent conversation.

reset_every.description: Rotate stateful worker session every N iterations (state_mode='stateful').

workspace.description: Agent workspace isolation mode passed to workflow agent() calls.

model.description: Worker model tier or slug (e.g. inherit, flash_lite, flash, pro).

verify.description: Enable Stage 2 independent read-only loop-verifier gate whenever worker reports DONE.

verifier_model.description: Model tier or slug for Stage 2 loop-verifier (default 'pro').

verify_cmd.description: Explicit Stage 1 deterministic shell command run when worker reports DONE (0 LLM tokens).

verify_timeout_sec.description: Timeout in seconds for Stage 1 verify_cmd (default 60).

probe_cmd.description: Explicit shell pre-check command executed before each iteration.

probe_until_pass.description: Exit DONE with 0 LLM tokens as soon as probe_cmd exits 0.

targets.description: Optional list of targets executed concurrently per iteration via parallel().

max_tokens.description: Hard cumulative token budget across the workflow.

max_duration_sec.description: Hard wall-clock budget in seconds across the workflow.

max_agents.description: Hard budget on total workflow agent instances spawned.

include_trajectory.description: Fetch bounded prior run_command trajectory context once at workflow startup.

state_dir.description: Optional override for loop state root directory (defaults to AGY_LOOP_STATE_DIR or <workspace_dir>/.agents/.agy-loop).
